column1: # ci_fast_gate_coverage.tsv — what scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh verifies, per lane.
# One row per job in `gate.needs` (.github/workflows/ci.yml) — the merge gate.
# scripts/test_ci_gate_structure.sh fails when this file and `gate.needs` drift
# apart in EITHER direction, and when a lane token here is not a lane the
# dispatcher actually assigns, so a new required producer — or a renamed lane —
# can never be omitted from the local gate's own coverage report in silence
# Columns, TAB separated:
#   job            the ci.yml job id, exactly as `gate.needs` spells it
#   full-lanes     comma-separated lanes that run a local equivalent of its checks
#   partial-lanes  comma-separated lanes that run only SOME of them
#   note-full      what runs, shown when the running lane is in full-lanes
#   note-partial   what is missing or why nothing runs, shown when the running
#                  lane is in partial-lanes OR in neither
# Lanes: docs, ci, code, full. "-" means no lane.
# A note is never dropped: an explanation that only reaches the reader for the
# `partial` case is missing exactly where it matters most — the checks that no
# lane covers at all.
# `full`/`partial` are declarations of what each lane is BUILT to verify, not a
# measurement of a particular run: a step that skipped because a tool was
# missing prints its own SKIP line in the run itself.
